text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #666666

g.text: colour = % of substrates carrying that residue at that position · rows alphabetical · this is not an enrichment scale

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Colour and cell text are the same number: the percentage of the n = 20 P/G-D/E/T substrates with that residue at that position (one peptide = 5%). Blank = 0%, no peptide in the group. Rows are alphabetical; the chip beside each label is its chemical class.

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: This is composition, NOT enrichment — a residue frequent here may be just as frequent among the controls. * = the cell also differs between the two groups at Fisher exact p < 0.05 (18 of 416 testable residue cells, against 21 expected by chance alone; none survives FDR correction). Compare with Figure 18b / 19b for the other

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: group, and with Figures 16–17 for significance.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Residue frequency by position — the 20 P/G-D/E/T substrates
